card.name: Words just before a named Asian item
card.fires_on: Small linking words (a, as, back, called, 's, comma) right before a specific non-Western name, such as a Chinese or Japanese product, brand, or place, in news text about China, Japan or Turkey.

modes.label: Verb or article in Asian space news
modes.description: A word like a or back in a report about a Chinese lunar mission.

card.writes: It nudges the next word toward Chinese brand and company names such as Xiaomi and Bai, and away from North American place names.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words just before a Chinese or other Asian name is expected.
